step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture details the flow from an AT&T LTE-M physical button to AWS cloud services via AWS IoT 1-Click. A button press sends a signal over the AT&T LTE-M network securely using TLS/x.509 certificates to AWS IoT 1-Click. AWS IoT 1-Click invokes a Lambda function, which then executes logic that can write to/read from DynamoDB, trigger SNS notifications, or send emails using SES.
